limitation: Both source-traced surface bands contact preserved same-specimen LGN labels. Contact is a teaching-scale segmentation relationship, not proof of individual fibre trajectories or precise deep and terminal boundaries. Full optic radiations remain unsegmented. Not expert-reviewed.

primaryReview.rationale: Seventeen native100 source/footprint views and ten final views support left Y725..805 and right Y735..815 surface bands. Gross shape and continuity, not exact pixel containment, define the teaching scope. Thirty-five existing LGN cells were preserved, four source-verified external/fissure centres excluded, and five new detached scope-edge cells held. No automatic path joining or other-specimen label transfer.
